subject: MedGov private deployment: preflight safety net and tenant readiness
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Rios <sofia.rios@medgov.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MedGov private deployment: initial preflight and quick checklist

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private deployment. Before we lock in the kickoff, I wanted to run a short, pragmatic preflight to make sure we have the right owners and evidence in place. TL;DR: we need network reachability items, KMS/Kafka (if applicable) handoffs, and the SOC2 evidence list you mentioned.

Can you confirm the target environment (VPC region and dedicated VLAN) and share the SOC2 evidence doc (or point me to the procurement ticket)? I attached a one-page checklist for what we usually validate during day0.

High level asks (one-line):
- Confirm VPC CIDR(s) and preferred region
- Share primary contact for networking and an ops slack/channel
- Confirm KMS provider (AWS KMS / customer HSM) and key alias
- Any compliance-specific log retention windows beyond 90 days?

Proposed next step: 30-min technical handoff Wed 10/31 10:00 PT — happy to shift if your engs need another time.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: medgov-onboard-day0-checklist.pdf (1 page summary)

Subject: Re: MedGov private deployment: initial preflight and quick checklist

Rishi —

Thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers inline:
- Environment: us-west-2, dedicated VPC, primary CIDR 10.12.0.0/16 (we'll carve subnets for infra/services).
- Networking contact: Diego Alvarez (diego.alvarez@medgov.com) — I've cc'd procurement for the contract ticket.
- KMS: Customer-managed AWS KMS, key alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11-bb22-cc33
- Retention: Audit logs must be retained 365 days; telemetry metrics can be 90 days.

Attaching the SOC2 evidence request from procurement. Wed 10/31 10:00 PT works for Diego and our infra lead.

-Sofia
Director, IT Operations | MedGov Health

Team — forwarding MedGov's quick answers + SOC2 evidence request (attached). Please see the asks below; I'll run the Wed 10/31 10:00 PT call and would like concrete confirmation before then.

Key action items for internal owners:
- Ben: confirm Dedicated tenancy model and capacity targets for us-west-2; need the suggested GPU profile and approximate QPS for pricing baseline.
- Kimberly: network/CNI and peering checklist + recommended firewall allowlist (MedGov expects 365d audit log retention — ensure our log export path and storage plan meets that).
- Naomi: compliance/evidence owner — please review SOC2 ask and identify any evidence gaps and templated artifacts we can provide quickly.

MedGov specifics: VPC 10.12.0.0/16, AWS KMS customer key, 365d audit retention required. They confirmed Diego (networking) for the handoff.

I'll capture any items in the MLP (mutual action plan) during the call. If any of you can't make the Wed slot, flag now and I'll reschedule.

Thanks —
Rishi

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-31T07:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedGov private deployment: initial preflight and quick checklist

Rishi / Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick tech-readiness notes for Wed's call and the doc we should prepare:

Network posture summary (short):
- Peering: We'll provision a dedicated transit VPC in us-west-2 and establish VPC peering with MedGov's 10.12.0.0/16 range; route table entries will be scoped to /24 per subnet.
- Firewall: Required outbound allowlist from MedGov to Redwood control plane:
  - 52.24.98.10/32 (control-plane-api) TCP 443
  - 3.214.12.0/24 (telemetry-ingest) TCP 443
  - For agent-initiated tunnel: 443/UDP 1194 (tunneled dataplane)
- Bastion/Jumphost: Customer-managed bastion preferred; we can operate via a short-lived jumpbox if they require us to validate.

Logging and retention:
- Audit logs: we will export application audit logs to MedGov S3 bucket (controlled with kms:Encrypt) with an enforced lifecycle of 365d — will need write policy for redwood-infra role.
- Metrics: retained 90d in our hosted observability; aggregated telemetry can be exported if they need longer windows.

Attachments: I attached a first-draft network diagram (network-diagram-draft.vsdx) and a sample IAM policy snippet for cross-account write to the S3 audit bucket.

Open questions for MedGov on the call:
1) Will MedGov provide an S3 bucket (preferred) or do they want Redwood to host audit archives?
2) Do they require mutual TLS for control-plane endpoints or will IP allowlist + signed client cert suffice?

I can cover the network/ops checklist on the call; Naomi — would you confirm the evidence matrix items you'll request and any gaps we should prepare for?

-Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: network-diagram-draft.vsdx; s3-cross-account-policy-snippet.txt

Sofia / Diego —

Great call today. Summary and concrete next steps below (short, with owners and dates). Please flag if anything needs correction.

Summary highlights:
- Environment: us-west-2, VPC 10.12.0.0/16 confirmed.
- KMS: customer-managed AWS KMS agreed; Diego will provide exact key policy by 11/05.
- Logs: MedGov will provide S3 bucket medgov-audit-logs-usw2; Redwood to get cross-account write policy in place.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego (MedGov): share S3 bucket name and attach write role ARN by 2025-11-05.
- Naomi (Redwood): evidence gap analysis and SOC2 artifact list to MedGov by 2025-11-07.
- Kimberly (Redwood): finalize firewall allowlist and deliver network diagram v2 by 2025-11-06.
- Ben (Redwood): draft Dedicated provisioning note & pricing estimate for the committed capacity ask by 2025-11-07.
- Rishi (Redwood): prepare the MLP (mutual action plan) and follow up on DocuSign envelope for procurement.

Attachments referenced during call: medgov-soc2-evidence-request.pdf (from procurement), network-diagram-draft.vsdx (Kim's first draft). I'll include the MLP link once created.

Next meeting: check-in 11/09 09:00 PT to validate artifacts and confirm day0 smoke test schedule.

Thanks all —
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
